brief:
A United Nations delegation arrived in the village of Qassra, south of Nablus, delivering food and supply materials to residents living in besieged homes, the Ma'an news agency reported. The mission brought provisions to address acute shortages facing the community.

The delivery marked a rare instance of humanitarian access to the area, where movement restrictions have severely limited residents' ability to obtain basic necessities. Officials did not disclose the quantity of aid delivered or details about the circumstances that led to the homes becoming isolated from surrounding supply networks.
title: UN delegation delivers food aid to besieged homes in West Bank village
